objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: Explicitly supplied AgentOwnedCandidateRoots are sufficient for CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY outside the active project even without a ledger match.
KEEP_ACTIVE has higher precedence than candidate-root membership.
Each item includes required evidence_source and required size_bytes.
Exact provenance match remains exact normalized path only; no filename heuristics.
Script remains non-destructive and default output is stdout.
retry_reason: Final pre-Astra consistency correction: documentation says an explicitly supplied AgentOwnedCandidateRoot is sufficient for CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY, but the external-root scan currently requires a provenance ledger match. Align implementation and schema evidence before Astra review.
orchestrator_corrections: For any file under an explicitly supplied AgentOwnedCandidateRoot, classify it CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY even when provenance_match=false. This is review-only, never automatic removal.
Preserve KEEP_ACTIVE precedence for any active orchestrator file, even if it also falls under a supplied candidate root.
Add an evidence_source field to each audit item with enum values EXACT_PROVENANCE_MATCH, EXPLICIT_AGENT_OWNED_ROOT, ACTIVE_PROJECT, or NONE, and require it in the JSON schema.
Require size_bytes in the JSON schema because the script always emits it.
Keep all other safety controls unchanged: no deletion/uninstall/registry/service changes, empty candidate roots by default, stdout by default, Google Drive state, pending Astra review.
Use exact worker model gemini-3.1-flash-lite in provenance-bearing filenames and metadata.
